watchOS 27.2 will launch next month, bringing new Apple Watch features, and tipster pdfu has recently discovered major changes coming to the screenshot functionality.

watchOS 27.2 code features a new screenshot experience inspired by the iPhone

Tipster pdfu has recently started sharing multiple details discovered from Apple's code. For example, he was the first to discover the Readiness app in watchOS 27, and yesterday he also leaked the HomePod Siri AI interface first.

In a new article today, pdfu revealed that the watchOS 27.2 beta contains code related to a revamped Apple Watch screenshot experience.

Currently, taking a screenshot on Apple Watch only causes the screen to flash, and then the screenshot is added to your Photos library.

The new screenshot workflow mimics what iPhone and iPad currently do, allowing you to choose to immediately share or delete the screenshot.

It is currently unclear whether Apple plans to implement this change in the upcoming watchOS 27.2 beta, or whether it still needs more time to develop. However, even if it ultimately doesn't make it into watchOS 27.2, Apple Watch is very likely to see this feature in the near future.

What do you think of the new screenshot experience leaked from watchOS 27.2? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
